topic.title: Geometric Learning on Point Clouds
topic.overview: Point clouds describe shape without a fixed image grid, so models must handle unordered samples, changing resolution, and spatial transformations. This cluster studies hierarchical features, self-supervision, detection, data distillation, and adaptable encoders for 3D inputs. Geometry-aware attention extends the same questions to features defined in different local coordinate systems.
topic.whyItMatters: A representation that depends on arbitrary point order or orientation can fail despite observing the same object. Efficient learning must preserve shape information while accommodating sparse measurements and heterogeneous acquisition conditions.
topic.evolution: The collection begins with point-cloud kernels and scene labeling, followed by hierarchical point-set networks. Later work adds few-shot detection, densification, and in-context understanding. Recent examples distill rotation-invariant synthetic data, tune topology-aware prompts, and use parallel transport to compare geometrically aligned features across domains.
openQuestions: How can one encoder remain reliable across sensors, densities, and coordinate conventions?
What information must synthetic point clouds preserve to transfer between architectures?

papers.title: DyPolySeg: Taylor Series-Inspired Dynamic Polynomial Fitting Network for Few-shot Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation
papers.tldr: DyPolySeg combines dynamic polynomial geometry features and prototype completion for leading few-shot point cloud segmentation without pre-training.

papers.title: Efficient LiDAR Reflectance Compression via Scanning Serialization
papers.tldr: SerLiC compresses LiDAR reflectance by modeling scan-ordered sequences, achieving strong compression with a small parameter count.

papers.title: Exploring Vision Semantic Prompt for Efficient Point Cloud Understanding
papers.tldr: Frozen 2D visual models supply semantic prompts that a compact attention adapter integrates into pretrained 3D point-cloud representations.

papers.title: GAPrompt: Geometry-Aware Point Cloud Prompt for 3D Vision Model
papers.tldr: GAPrompt incorporates local and global point-cloud geometry into efficient adaptation, achieving competitive results with only 2.19% trainable parameters.

papers.title: Generative Point Cloud Registration
papers.tldr: Match-ControlNet generates geometrically aligned, texture-consistent image pairs to enrich point cloud registration with complementary color features.

papers.title: Geometric Feature Embedding for Effective 3D Few-Shot Class Incremental Learning
papers.tldr: 3D-FLEG enriches text prompts with point-cloud geometry to learn new categories from few examples while mitigating forgetting.

papers.title: InfoCons: Identifying Interpretable Critical Concepts in Point Clouds via Information Theory
papers.tldr: InfoCons explains point-cloud predictions through meaningful 3D subsets that connect conceptual structure with predictive influence.

papers.title: LOCATE 3D: Real-World Object Localization via Self-Supervised Learning in 3D
papers.tldr: LOCATE 3D combines self-supervised point-cloud learning with language-conditioned decoding to locate objects directly from RGB-D sensor observations.

papers.title: Point Cloud Dataset Distillation
papers.tldr: DD3D distills point-cloud datasets using orientation alignment and a variable-resolution generator to improve scalability and reduce memory use.

papers.title: Rethinking Point Cloud Data Augmentation: Topologically Consistent Deformation
papers.tldr: SinPoint improves point-cloud augmentation through smooth topology-preserving deformations and randomized combinations of basic transformations.

papers.title: SMART-PC: Skeletal Model Adaptation for Robust Test-Time Training in Point Clouds
papers.tldr: SMART-PC learns skeletal point-cloud features and adapts only BatchNorm statistics, improving reported corruption robustness and efficiency without test-time backpropagation.

papers.title: Towards Learning to Complete Anything in Lidar
papers.tldr: CAL learns from partial shapes in multimodal sequences to support Lidar-only completion and recognition beyond fixed object vocabularies.

papers.title: Unpaired Point Cloud Completion via Unbalanced Optimal Transport
papers.tldr: UOT-UPC learns point-cloud completion from unpaired data using unbalanced optimal transport, with particular robustness to class imbalance.

papers.title: APML: Adaptive Probabilistic Matching Loss for Robust 3D Point Cloud Reconstruction
papers.tldr: APML uses differentiable probabilistic matching to improve point-cloud coverage while avoiding the cubic cost of exact matching.

papers.title: Asymmetric Dual Self-Distillation for 3D Self-Supervised Representation Learning
papers.tldr: AsymDSD combines masked latent prediction and invariance learning to improve self-supervised representations of 3D point clouds.

papers.title: Attention on the Sphere
papers.tldr: Spherical attention incorporates the sphere's geometry into Transformers and outperforms planar counterparts across three evaluated tasks.

papers.title: BeyondMix: Leveraging Structural Priors and Long-Range Dependencies for Domain-Invariant LiDAR Segmentation
papers.tldr: BeyondMix combines point-cloud structural properties with Mamba-based long-range modeling to improve unsupervised LiDAR segmentation adaptation.

papers.title: Complete Structure Guided Point Cloud Completion via Cluster- and Instance-Level Contrastive Learning
papers.tldr: The framework learns complete-shape guidance from incomplete point clouds and uses two levels of contrastive learning to preserve shape and detail.

papers.title: D$^2$GS: Dense Depth Regularization for LiDAR-free Urban Scene Reconstruction
papers.tldr: D²GS reconstructs urban scenes without LiDAR by jointly refining Gaussian geometry and dense predicted depth.

papers.title: Dataset Distillation of 3D Point Clouds via Distribution Matching
papers.tldr: The method distills 3D point-cloud datasets by jointly learning synthetic shapes and rotations with a semantically aligned distribution-matching loss.

papers.title: GeGS-PCR: Fast and Robust Color 3D Point Cloud Registration with Two-Stage Geometric-3DGS Fusion
papers.tldr: GeGS-PCR combines color, geometry, and Gaussian representations to improve point cloud alignment under low overlap and incomplete observations.

papers.title: GTR-Loc: Geospatial Text Regularization Assisted Outdoor LiDAR Localization
papers.tldr: GTR-Loc uses geospatial text to improve LiDAR localization during learning, then distills that knowledge for LiDAR-only inference.

papers.title: How Many Tokens Do 3D Point Cloud Transformer Architectures Really Need?
papers.tldr: A token-merging method cuts token counts by up to 90–95% in tested 3D point-cloud Transformers while preserving competitive performance.

papers.title: L2RSI: Cross-view LiDAR-based Place Recognition for Large-scale Urban Scenes via Remote Sensing Imagery
papers.tldr: L2RSI locates urban LiDAR scans using overhead imagery, combining semantic alignment with spatial and temporal prediction refinement.

papers.title: Novel Class Discovery for Point Cloud Segmentation via Joint Learning of Causal Representation and Reasoning
papers.tldr: The method combines causal class prototypes with graph-based reasoning to discover unlabeled segmentation categories from labeled base classes.

papers.title: On Geometry-Enhanced Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for 3D Scene Segmentation
papers.tldr: GEM adds local and global geometry to efficient point-cloud adaptation, matching or sometimes exceeding full fine-tuning with 1.6% of parameters updated.

papers.title: Point Cloud Synthesis Using Inner Product Transforms
papers.tldr: An inner-product-based point-cloud encoding combines provable expressivity with high-quality reconstruction, generation, and interpolation at substantially faster inference speeds.

papers.title: Point-MaDi: Masked Autoencoding with Diffusion for Point Cloud Pre-training
papers.tldr: Point-MaDi learns point-cloud structure by jointly denoising patch centers and reconstructing masked patches, improving downstream three-dimensional recognition.

papers.title: Point4Bit: Post Training 4-bit Quantization for Point Cloud 3D Detection
papers.tldr: Point4Bit enables 4-bit post-training quantization for voxel-based 3D detectors with a reported accuracy drop below 1.5%.

papers.title: PointMAC: Meta-Learned Adaptation for Robust Test-Time Point Cloud Completion
papers.tldr: PointMAC meta-learns self-supervised adaptation so a point cloud completion model can refine each test sample without additional labels.

papers.title: PointMapPolicy: Structured Point Cloud Processing for Multi-Modal Imitation Learning
papers.tldr: PointMapPolicy combines full-resolution structured 3D point grids with RGB observations to improve diffusion policies for robotic manipulation.

papers.title: PointTruss: K-Truss for Point Cloud Registration
papers.tldr: PointTruss uses triangle-supported graph structure, efficient sampling, and spatial coverage scoring to improve point cloud registration.

papers.title: Registration is a Powerful Rotation-Invariance Learner for 3D Anomaly Detection
papers.tldr: Jointly learning point-cloud registration and anomaly features improves rotation robustness and 3D defect detection in the reported experiments.

papers.title: TREND: Unsupervised 3D Representation Learning via Temporal Forecasting for LiDAR Perception
papers.tldr: TREND pretrains LiDAR representations by forecasting future observations, improving downstream detection and segmentation in reported evaluations.

papers.title: U-CAN: Unsupervised Point Cloud Denoising with Consistency-Aware Noise2Noise Matching
papers.tldr: U-CAN learns denoising from noisy observations using multistep predictions and consistency constraints, with competitive results across point-cloud and image tasks.

papers.title: ZigzagPointMamba: Spatial-Semantic Mamba for Point Cloud Understanding
papers.tldr: ZigzagPointMamba combines spatially coherent token ordering with semantic masking to improve learned point-cloud representations.

papers.title: 3D MeanFlow: One-Step Point Cloud Completion and Generation via Average-Velocity Transport
papers.tldr: 3D MeanFlow completes and generates point clouds in one sampling step, delivering faster sampling with competitive fidelity and improving evaluated object detectors.

papers.title: Any3D-VLA: Enhancing VLA Robustness via Diverse Point Clouds
papers.tldr: Any3D-VLA combines images with diverse point clouds to improve robot performance and reduce differences across environments.

papers.title: FoundObj: Self-supervised Foundation Models as Rewards for Label-free 3D Object Segmentation
papers.tldr: FoundObj learns to merge 3D point groups into objects using semantic and geometric rewards from self-supervised foundation models.

papers.title: PACE: Post-Causal Entropy Modeling for Learned LiDAR Point Cloud Compression
papers.tldr: PACE separates context aggregation from causal prediction to improve LiDAR compression and sharply reduce decoding latency.

papers.title: PointCHR: Point Cloud Analysis via Curvature-Aware Hyperbolic Rectification
papers.tldr: PointCHR uses curvature-guided hyperbolic embeddings to give sparse, detailed point-cloud regions more representational capacity.

papers.title: PSMix: Robust Point Cloud Recognition through Spectral Domain Mixing
papers.tldr: PSMix improves point-cloud robustness by mixing spectral coefficients to preserve global geometry while varying details and training against difficult rotations.

papers.title: QPoint: End-to-End Lightweight Point Cloud Processing via Robust Quaternion Feature Learning
papers.tldr: QPoint combines quaternion-based local features and global attention for efficient, rotation-robust point-cloud processing.

papers.title: RGGT: A Generative-Prior-Guided Transformer for Unified Rigid and Non-Rigid Point Cloud Registration
papers.tldr: RGGT combines generative priors, cross-shape attention, and joint supervision to achieve reported state-of-the-art rigid and non-rigid point-cloud registration in one framework.

papers.title: Scalable and Differentiable Point-Cloud Registration Using Maximum Mean Discrepancy
papers.tldr: MMD-Reg provides correspondence-free point-cloud alignment with linear complexity and a differentiable solution that can serve as a trainable model layer.

papers.title: Scalable Event Cloud Network for Event-based Classification
papers.tldr: SECNet combines polarity-aware event grouping with Fourier-domain feature extraction to make event-cloud classification more scalable and efficient.

papers.title: SG2Loc: Sequential Visual Localization on 3D Scene Graphs
papers.tldr: SG2Loc localizes a camera over time by matching image semantics against a compact 3D object graph within a particle filter.

papers.title: SIMPC: Learning Self-Induced Mirror-Point Consistency for Unsupervised Point Cloud Denoising
papers.tldr: SIMPC denoises point clouds by making noisy points and generated mirror counterparts agree on their underlying surface.

papers.title: SplAttN: Bridging 2D and 3D with Gaussian Soft Splatting and Attention for Point Cloud Completion
papers.tldr: SplAttN uses continuous Gaussian projection to strengthen image–point-cloud connections and improve three-dimensional completion.

papers.title: TopAdapter: Topology-Aware Prompt Tuning for Efficient Point Cloud Understanding
papers.tldr: TopAdapter injects and propagates local topological features to achieve point-cloud adaptation performance comparable to full fine-tuning.

papers.title: Utonia: Toward One Encoder for All Point Clouds
papers.tldr: Utonia jointly learns from diverse point-cloud domains, producing transferable features that also improve manipulation and spatial reasoning.

papers.title: VBA: Vector Bundle Attention for Intrinsically Geometric Representation Learning
papers.tldr: VBA aligns features across local coordinate systems before attention comparisons, improving biological benchmarks and achieving competitive 3D point-cloud accuracy.
